matchupWindow.method: Last 30 days, never before the current patch release (a patch younger than 7 days is filled up to 7 days with pre-patch days at weight 0.25). STRATZ publishes matchups only per weekly bucket, so each week is weighted by the share of its covered time that falls inside the window.

population.description: Rank-bracket data (calibrated ranks: Herald through Immortal)

synergy.perspective: wins = wins of the team with both heroes (same-team "with" rows, both directions averaged)

roleStats.format: { ALL | <bracket>: { heroId: [[games, wins] for positions 1..5] } }, ALL = sum of the brackets

brackets.allRanks: matchups.json = sum of the raw bracket tables (= the combined all-bracket query)
brackets.perBracket: STRATZ applies the bracket to one player of a pair, so A→B and B→A differ within a bracket; each bracket table averages both directions (matches where either hero was played in that bracket).

population.description: Rank-bracket data (calibrated ranks: Herald through Immortal)

eligibility.rule: hard gate — a hero must clear both thresholds for a position to be ranked there

schema.winsPerspective: wins = wins of the KEY hero (the enemy facing the candidates) — identical convention to OpenDota
